# Paired Strategy Report fixtures

`BDS_TXF.srp` and `BDS_TXF.sea` come from `/home/jack/git/sea_spec/examples/srp/BDS_TXF/` at `sea_spec` commit `3147682`. The SEA file packages that example's `strategy.toml` and `events.jsonl` without modifying their contents. The files encode the same transactions in two supported input formats and are used for deterministic local and CI parity checks.
